import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    readings = inputs["readings"].copy()

    cols = ["batch_id", "reading_id", "sensor", "value"]

    is_bad = readings["value"].isna() | (readings["value"] < 0) | (readings["value"] > 1000)
    readings["_is_bad"] = is_bad

    batch_stats = readings.groupby("batch_id")["_is_bad"].agg(
        total_rows="count",
        bad_row_count="sum"
    ).reset_index()

    batch_stats["quarantined"] = batch_stats["bad_row_count"] * 100 > batch_stats["total_rows"] * 20
    batch_stats["batch_reject_pct"] = (batch_stats["bad_row_count"] * 100.0 / batch_stats["total_rows"]).round(2)

    readings = readings.merge(
        batch_stats[["batch_id", "quarantined", "batch_reject_pct"]],
        on="batch_id",
        how="left"
    )

    quarantine_mask = readings["quarantined"] == True

    quarantine_df = readings.loc[quarantine_mask, cols + ["batch_reject_pct"]].copy()

    remaining = readings.loc[~quarantine_mask].copy()

    clean_df = remaining.loc[~remaining["_is_bad"], cols].copy()
    rejects_df = remaining.loc[remaining["_is_bad"], cols].copy()

    clean_df = clean_df.reset_index(drop=True)
    rejects_df = rejects_df.reset_index(drop=True)
    quarantine_df = quarantine_df.reset_index(drop=True)

    return {
        "readings_clean": clean_df,
        "readings_rejects": rejects_df,
        "readings_quarantine": quarantine_df,
    }
